ideas.pitch: A mini-RPG where players use live voice input to converse with AI-driven NPCs whose dialogue and quests adapt in real-time to the player's spoken intent.
ideas.title: Voice-First NPC Dynamic Quest Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates complex real-time voice handling and AI integration under a tight game jam schedule, following the technical ambition seen in top AI hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent that plays through dynamically generated dungeon crawler levels, optimizing pathfinding and combat strategies live on screen.
ideas.title: Autonomous Agentic Bot for Procedural Dungeons
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced agentic workflows which heavily impress judges looking for technical depth beyond standard gameplay scripts.

ideas.pitch: A continuous generative 2D world where the environment and narrative twists dynamically alter mid-stream based on live spectator chat or voting inputs.
ideas.title: Echoes of Incarnia: Live Audience-Pivoted World Model
ideas.why_it_could_win: Incorporates live interactive state transitions that make the live presentation stand out instantly to judges.

ideas.pitch: An educational visual novel game featuring branching dialogue trees focused on water conservation technologies and real-world resource management.
ideas.title: AquaQuest: Conservation Visual Novel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Strong narrative focus combined with a polished retro aesthetic resonates well with game jam judges looking for cohesive storytelling.

ideas.pitch: A fast-paced retro arcade minigame where players collect tokens and test simulated smart contract transactions under high-pressure platformer mechanics.
ideas.title: Token Tap: Retro Arcade Minigame with Mock Finance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines addictive retro game mechanics with seamless minigame loops, proven to be a winning formula in retro gaming events.
